items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: He worked with us for quite awhile.

ctx.x: -- he did a guest spot and then when he came over here he did a guest spot. We brought him over here. I mean, Ellington brought him over here and oh, yes, he really registered with the American audience.
We talked a little bit about Shorty (inaudible) Baker, ah, how did you feel about his playing?

I think he was one of the best of the best. He worked with us for quite awhile. His lush tone, and his beautiful way of making his passages and the things that he picked out to make in his passages, were really something terrific. He was originally with what's that girl piano player?
